description: The pie chart titled “Token Routing Distribution (FedHLM)” depicts how tokens are distributed across routing destinations, and it contains three slices. The largest slice is labeled “LOCAL,” shown in green, and is annotated as 94.5%. A smaller slice labeled “LLM,” shown in red, is annotated as 3.9%. The smallest slice labeled “EDGE_P2P,” shown in blue, is annotated as 1.6%. Percentage values are printed inside the slices, there is no separate legend, and none of the slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized beyond their size; the slices are visually dominated by the large green LOCAL segment.
